protocol_note: Three new, mutually distinct long/flat daily ETF hypotheses are evaluated as ONE batch through the existing registered economic_walk_forward_v1 protocol. The decision stream of every trial is emitted by the real native Rust strategy (mqk backtest native-signals); no trading rule is re-implemented in Python. Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice: three hypotheses, one trial per (hypothesis, symbol) = 15 trials, retries after infrastructure failure are new attempts of the same trial.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: A liquid ETF whose latest completed close exceeds its close exactly 252 completed trading bars earlier has positive trailing one-year price momentum, which tends to continue enough to justify long exposure after conservative costs; otherwise the strategy is flat.
primary_references: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012), 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2):228-250
Jegadeesh and Titman (1993), 'Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers', Journal of Finance 48(1):65-91
hypotheses.rule: For the latest completed bar t with completed closes c: reference = the close exactly 252 completed bars before t. TARGET +1 share iff c_t > reference (strict); otherwise 0. Equality is flat. Never short.
hypotheses.exact_integer_form: long iff close_micros[t] > close_micros[t-252]; i64 comparison, no division

special_cases.incomplete_latest_bar: FLAT (an incomplete bar cannot create an action)

hypotheses.state: stateless: a pure function of the latest 253 completed bars

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Liquid ETFs that trade within 3 percent of their trailing 252-day closing high while remaining above their 50-day mean exhibit persistent momentum; otherwise the strategy is flat.
primary_references: George and Hwang (2004), 'The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing', Journal of Finance 59(5):2145-2176
hypotheses.rule: high252 = the maximum close over the latest 252 completed closes (including t); sum50 = the sum of the latest 50 completed closes (including t). TARGET +1 share iff BOTH 100*c_t >= 97*high252 (equality included) AND 50*c_t > sum50 (strict); otherwise 0. Never short.
hypotheses.exact_integer_form: long iff 100*c >= 97*high252 and 50*c > sum50; i128 over integer micros, no division
hypotheses.state: stateless: a pure function of the latest 252 completed bars

hypotheses.economic_rationale: A sharp five-session pullback that occurs while a liquid ETF remains in a long-term uptrend tends to mean-revert over the following several sessions; the long target persists for the five evaluation bars that follow an entry event, with no hidden mutable state.
primary_references: Jegadeesh (1990), 'Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns', Journal of Finance 45(3):881-898
Lehmann (1990), 'Fads, Martingales, and Market Efficiency', Quarterly Journal of Economics 105(1):1-28
hypotheses.required_history_derivation: an entry event on bar j needs the 200 completed closes ending at j and close[j-5]; the target at t inspects j in {t-4..t}; the oldest event bar t-4 therefore needs 200 closes ending at t-4, i.e. 204 completed closes ending at t
hypotheses.rule: ENTRY EVENT on completed bar j iff BOTH 200*c_j > sum of the 200 completed closes ending at j (strict) AND 100*c_j <= 96*c_{j-5} (equality included; at least a 4 percent decline from the close five completed bars earlier). TARGET at t = +1 share iff at least one valid ENTRY EVENT occurred on any of the five completed bars t, t-1, t-2, t-3, t-4; otherwise 0. Overlapping events extend the target exactly by this rule. Never short.
hypotheses.exact_integer_form: event(j) iff 200*c_j > sum200(j) and 100*c_j <= 96*c_{j-5}; i128 over integer micros, no division
hypotheses.state: stateless and restart-reconstructible: a pure function of the latest 204 completed bars; a fresh instance and a long-running instance produce the same target

universe.selection_rule: The five asset-class proxies of Faber (2007)'s GTAA list that exist as enabled ETFs in config/instruments/equities.json: US equities, foreign developed equities, 10-year Treasuries, US real estate, commodities. DBC/GSCI is not in the registry; GLD is the registry's commodity proxy.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean. Each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all five, so selection among them is accounted for; residual survivorship of the list itself is a stated limitation.
universe.population_note: Same fixed list as the four closed families. Their trial attempts live in their own experiment ids and registries (intraday_scalper, trend_sma50, dual_sma_50_200_trend, pullback_mean_reversion_20_2); they are disclosed by name here and are not merged into this batch's registry, which would not be the canonical scope rule (scope = experiment_id).
universe.trial_order_rule: frozen: H1, H2, H3; within each, SPY, EFA, IEF, VNQ, GLD

experiment.population_policy: ONE experiment id holds the three hypotheses and all fifteen trials. The multiple-testing judge scope is the experiment id with hypothesis_id unset, so every trial of every hypothesis is in one selection population; its comparison key excludes strategy and hypothesis identity, so all fifteen share one comparison scope. No per-hypothesis judge is used for selection; losing and failed trials are never excluded by hand.

fallback_if_corporate_action_gate_refuse.note: Boundary already established as corporate-action-safe by prior campaigns. Used only if the fail-closed gate refuses the primary window; declared now, before any result.

reuse_verified_data_from.rule: byte-identical reuse after verifying the provenance manifest artifact_sha256 and row_count against the CSV; no new provider call

partition.holdout_rule: last 6 calendar months of the dataset, reserved_not_evaluated, never consumed by this campaign
partition.warmup_note: The partition is carried over unchanged from the closed campaigns. The Rust emitter receives bars from 2016-01-04; the 252/253/204-bar warm-ups end during 2016-2017, so the early part of fold 1 is structurally flat for the affected engines.

native_backtest.initial_cash_rule: USD 1,000 for every symbol, fixed now; one share of every listed symbol costs less than this over the whole window
native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

robustness.source_note: Reuses the finite values the Wave06 campaign already froze before its results; the notional cap is half the single-symbol long-only natural position (equity_usd x max_gross_exposure = 100,000).

scanner_review.policy: mqk_backtest::StrategyScanReviewPolicy::default (min_bars 252, min_trades 5, min_return_pct 0, min_alpha_pct 0, max_drawdown_pct 25, min_profit_factor 1.05) -- unchanged
scanner_review.data: the same discovery-only converted bars (truncated at the holdout start), one registry/bars root per campaign run

promotion_policy.note: No canonical production threshold values exist in the deployed configuration. These are fixed now, before any result, and are supplied to the daemon only for the promotion transition.

rejection_gates: economic evaluation fails or is insolvent
judge not evaluable (DSR/PBO) or DSR below promotion_policy minimum or PBO above maximum
any required robustness scenario fails or is not evaluable (canonical P9 gauntlet, genuine shuffled placebo, P7A/P7B stress, DSR/PBO block-count sensitivity)
any promotion_policy threshold fails in canonical evaluate_promotion

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulated discrete share position (held before that bar's order) agrees, long vs flat, with the executed desired weight; positions only, never P&L
execution_fidelity.enforced_by: mqk_research.ml.native_signal_registry_integration.NATIVE_EXECUTION_FIDELITY_FLOOR; an attempt below the floor is finalized failed and kept

sizing_note: Carried forward unchanged from campaign 03 / the dual-SMA campaign (equity_usd 100000, max_position_notional_usd 50000, stress cap 25000 = half of baseline so P7B stays strictly tighter). It was validated for execution fidelity, not chosen for profitability.
review_and_promotion_freeze: scanner_review policy (including the min_alpha_pct 0 versus a fully invested buy-and-hold price return), promotion_policy thresholds, the baseline execution model rust_conservative_bar_range_v1 and the P9 robustness scenarios (including month_year_regime_concentration) are carried over byte-for-byte from the closed campaigns and are not reopened by any observed result.

selection_authority.eligibility: a trial is eligible only if it clears every rejection gate in the canonical path
selection_authority.rule: among eligible trials select the single trial with the highest judge DSR; ties broken by the lexicographically smallest trial_id

activity_report.rule: measured and reported; no threshold is created from these numbers.

batch_stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same attempt/trial identity under the existing contract; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried

attempt_identity_rules: A retry after an infrastructure failure is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from strategy_id, symbol, native semantic fingerprint, bars provenance, partition policy and economic protocol only.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing the symbol list, any lookback, percentage, partition, costs, sizing, thresholds or review policy after seeing any result
defining identity from a result value
promoting any candidate by hand or outside the production transition route
adding any parameter, stop, filter or confirmation rule
running a per-hypothesis judge and selecting its best result as if the other hypotheses had not been tested
